sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B · Models
sources.snippet: To support the research community, we have open-sourced DeepSeek-R1-Zero, DeepSeek-R1, and six dense models distilled from DeepSeek-R1 based on Llama and Qwen. DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B outperforms OpenAI-o1-mini across various benchmarks, achieving new state-of-the-art results for dense models.

sources.title: Deepseek-R1-qwen1.5B - GitHub
sources.snippet: And the main project directory will be called Deepseek-R1-qwen1.5B Unzip all files in the llama-b4539-bin-win-vulkan-x64.zip archive into the llamacpp directory download the GGUF from the Bartowski repo I used the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B-Q6_K.gguf. Save the GGUF file in the subdirectory llamacpp\model.

sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B are derived from Qwen-2.5 series, which are originally licensed under Apache 2.0 License, and now finetuned with 800k samples curated with DeepSeek-R1.
